paper_title: Spectrum of global string networks and the axion dark matter mass
notes: This is a theory/simulation paper predicting the post-inflationary QCD axion dark matter mass range m_a ~ 95-450 ueV from global string network simulations. It is a prediction of the axion mass (related to f_a), not an experimental exclusion limit with a coupling-vs-mass curve. No extractable (mass, coupling) data points exist; the result is a single mass range. Not a new exclusion limit in the conventional sense. | read-vote N=3: ct=AxionMass (3/3); no consensus curve, took most-points
